title: Easy Manhunt
description: An easy way to host manhunts with your friends!
body:
**An easy way to host manhunts with your friends!**

This plugin allows you to **host manhunts with your friends** with the `/manhunt` command! To stop an ongoing one, use the command again.
**Temporarily deletes player data** (location, inventory, exp) & restores it after the manhunt has ended!

----------

By default, `/manhunt` is only usable by OP players. The permission string to use with a permissions manager is `easymanhunt.manhunt`.
